metadata.title: Why Tipra Motha Founder is Angry | Adivasi Protest in Assam | Manipur Violence | Tribal News
metadata.description: This week's bulletin from Main Bhi Bharat brings a comprehensive look at key issues across Tribal India. Tipra Motha's Founder expressed frustration over party leaders, accusing them of neglecting the development of their people and hinting at possible corruption among senior members. Meanwhile, Adivasi communities in Assam continue their protests demanding Scheduled Tribe (ST) status, echoing similar demonstrations recently seen in Meghalaya. We also highlight the alarming conditions of hostels in tribal area schools, where poor infrastructure and lack of basic amenities are creating hurdles for students' education. Stay tuned for these stories and more, as we report on the pressing challenges and voices from India's tribal heartlands.
